source.author: verg
source.text: Ipsa Paphum sublimis abit, sedesque revisit laeta suas, ubi templum illi, centumque Sabaeo ture calent arae, sertisque recentibus halant.
source.text_original: Ipsa Paphum sublimis abit, sedesque revisit / laeta suas, ubi templum illi, centumque Sabaeo / ture calent arae, sertisque recentibus halant.
source.text_english: She herself goes in exalted flight to Paphos, and joyfully revisits her own abode, where for her a temple stands, and a hundred altars glow with Sabaean incense and breathe with fresh garlands.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Centumque Sabaeo Thure calent arae: licet quidam Sabaeos, Arabes suspicentur.
reuse.text_original: Centumque Sabaeo Thure calent arae: licet quidam Sabaeos, Arabes suspicentur.
reuse.text_english: And a hundred altars glow with Sabæan frankincense; though some suspect that the Sabæans are Arabs.
